about.title: Gustine Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Gustine is a small town, and when someone dies here because another person or company was careless, the loss is felt on 4th Street, along 6th Avenue, and across the rest of Merced County. The 2025 public record for Gustine lists 8 injury collisions and 12 people hurt, with no traffic deaths that year, and that is worth saying plainly. Yet wrongful death claims in a town of 5,756 are not only about crashes on Rt 140 or Rt 33. They arise from equipment failures, unsafe worksites, medical errors, and other preventable events that take a parent, partner, or child. California gives the spouse or domestic partner and children the first right to bring a claim, and generally allows two years from the date of death to file, less if a public agency is involved. LawProactive is not a law firm. We are a free service that connects Gustine families with an independent attorney who handles wrongful death cases on contingency, so you owe nothing unless there is a recovery.

whyChoose.title: Why Gustine Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on Who Can File
items.desc: California limits wrongful death standing to the spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. The attorney we connect you with can sort out where your family stands before anything is filed.

items.title: Deadlines Handled Early
items.desc: Most claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window is shorter when a city, county, or state agency is involved. Getting an attorney in place promptly protects that timeline.

items.title: The Full Picture of Loss
items.desc: Recoverable losses under California law include funeral and burial costs, the financial support your loved one would have provided, and the loss of love, companionship, and guidance. Your attorney documents each of these, and works on contingency.

items.question: Gustine recorded no traffic deaths in 2025. Does that mean wrongful death claims are rare here?
items.answer: The 2025 public record does show 8 injury collisions and 12 people injured with no traffic fatalities in Gustine. Wrongful death claims, though, cover far more than crashes, including workplace incidents, medical negligence, and defective products. A small town's numbers say nothing about whether your family's specific loss was preventable, which is what an attorney will look at.

items.question: A criminal case is already open. Do we still need a civil claim?
items.answer: Yes, they are separate. A criminal prosecution is brought by the state and does not compensate your family for funeral costs, lost support, or the loss of companionship. A civil wrongful death action is the path for those losses and can move forward whether or not criminal charges are filed or succeed.

items.question: What does it cost to speak with an attorney through LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free connection service, not a law firm, and the independent attorneys in our network handle wrongful death cases on contingency. That means no attorney fee unless there is a recovery for your family.
